a.es: un; una; al (a year: al año)
a.ja: 一つの；〜につき（a year：一年に）

about.ex: The trip takes about two hours.

act.en: to behave or work in a certain way
act.ex: The old tree acts like a shelter for birds.
act.zh: 表現得像；扮演（act like：像…一樣行事）

addressed.ex: The council finally addressed the parking problem.
addressed.zh: 處理；解決（inadequately addressed：未妥善處理）

advocated.en: publicly supported an idea or plan
advocated.ex: Doctors advocated more exercise for children.

example.en: Many doctors advocate cycling to work.
example.zh: 許多醫生提倡騎自行車上班。

note.meaning: 公開支持或倡議某種做法、政策或理念。
note.usage: 常用 advocate + 名詞／V-ing（advocate change, advocate banning…）；不加 for 也可，但 advocate for 也常見。名詞 advocate 指「倡議者」。

noteEn.meaning: to publicly support an idea, plan or policy.

noteEs.exampleTr: Muchos médicos recomiendan ir al trabajo en bicicleta.
noteEs.meaning: apoyar o defender públicamente una idea o política.
noteEs.usage: Se usa advocate + sustantivo/V-ing (advocate change); también advocate for.

noteHi.exampleTr: कई डॉक्टर काम पर साइकिल से जाने की वकालत करते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: किसी विचार या नीति का सार्वजनिक रूप से समर्थन करना।
noteHi.usage: advocate + संज्ञा/V-ing (advocate change); advocate for भी प्रयोग होता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 多くの医師が自転車通勤を推奨している。
noteJa.meaning: ある考えや政策を公に支持・提唱すること。
noteJa.usage: advocate + 名詞／動名詞（advocate change）の形が基本。advocate for も使う。

noteKo.meaning: 어떤 생각이나 정책을 공개적으로 지지하고 주장하다.
noteKo.usage: advocate + 명사/동명사(advocate change) 형태가 기본이며 advocate for도 쓴다.

advocating.en: publicly supporting an idea or plan
advocating.ex: She spent years advocating cleaner rivers.
advocating.hi: समर्थन करते हुए; वकालत करते हुए

example.en: Many doctors advocate cycling to work.
example.zh: 許多醫生提倡騎自行車上班。

note.usage: 常用 advocate + 名詞／V-ing（advocate change, advocate banning…）；不加 for 也可，但 advocate for 也常見。名詞 advocate 指「倡議者」。

noteEs.exampleTr: Muchos médicos recomiendan ir al trabajo en bicicleta.

noteEs.usage: Se usa advocate + sustantivo/V-ing (advocate change); también advocate for.

noteHi.usage: advocate + संज्ञा/V-ing (advocate change); advocate for भी प्रयोग होता है।

noteJa.usage: advocate + 名詞／動名詞（advocate change）の形が基本。advocate for も使う。

noteKo.meaning: 어떤 생각이나 정책을 공개적으로 지지하고 주장하다.
noteKo.usage: advocate + 명사/동명사(advocate change) 형태가 기본이며 advocate for도 쓴다.

agency.en: a government body that does a special job
agency.ex: The agency checks the safety of drinking water.

alarm.en: a warning that something bad is happening
alarm.es: alarma (raise the alarm: dar la voz de alarma)
alarm.ex: Neighbours raised the alarm when they saw smoke.
alarm.hi: चेतावनी; ख़तरे की घंटी (raise the alarm)
alarm.ja: 警報（raise the alarm：警鐘を鳴らす）
alarm.zh: 警報（raise the alarm：發出警訊）

among.zh: 包括；在…之中（among them：其中包括）

angler.en: a person who catches fish with a rod
angler.ex: The angler waited quietly by the lake.

anglers.en: people who catch fish with a rod
anglers.ex: Anglers gathered at the river at dawn.

angry.ex: Parents were angry about the school closing.

annual.ex: The town holds an annual music festival.

aquaculture.en: farming fish or shellfish in water
aquaculture.ex: Aquaculture now supplies much of the world's seafood.

are.en: form of 'be' used with plural subjects

argue.en: to give reasons for what you believe
argue.ex: Some experts argue that the tax is unfair.

arguing.ex: He left the meeting arguing that the plan would fail.

as.en: in the role of; used in 'such as'
as.zh: 作為；當作（describe/cast X as Y）；such as：例如

back.en: to the place where it was before
back.ex: Please put the books back on the shelf.

basis.en: the way or system used to do something
basis.ex: Staff are paid on a weekly basis.
basis.zh: 基礎；方式（on a … basis：以…方式）

being.en: used for actions happening now in the passive

big.ex: The new park was a big change for the town.

bigger.ex: Traffic is a bigger problem than noise here.

blame.en: to say someone or something caused a problem
blame.ex: Farmers blame the dry weather for the poor harvest.

blamed.en: said to be the cause of a problem
blamed.ex: The driver was blamed for the accident.

blocks.ex: A fallen tree blocks the road.

by.en: done or made by; in 'by contrast'
by.zh: 由；被（by Inland Fisheries Ireland）；by contrast：相比之下

called.ja: 求めた（call for：〜を要求する）

came.ex: The birds came back in spring.

cap.en: an upper limit on an amount
cap.ex: The city put a cap on rent increases.

casts.en: describes someone as having a role
casts.ex: The film casts the mayor as a hero.
casts.hi: के रूप में पेश करता है (cast as)
casts.zh: 把…描繪成（cast X as Y）

catch.en: to take a fish out of water
catch.ex: We hope to catch a trout today.

catch-and-release.en: catching fish and then letting them go alive
catch-and-release.es: pesca sin muerte; captura y suelta
catch-and-release.ex: The lake allows catch-and-release fishing only.
catch-and-release.ja: キャッチ・アンド・リリース
catch-and-release.zh: 釣獲後放流（把魚釣上來再放回去）

change.en: a move to make something different
change.ex: The town needs real change in its transport.

changes.ex: The school made big changes to its timetable.

characterises.en: describes someone as a certain type
characterises.ex: The report characterises the plan as risky.
characterises.hi: के रूप में वर्णित करता है
characterises.zh: 把…描述為（characterise X as Y）

city.ex: Cork city sits on the River Lee.

close.en: to stop being open for use
close.ex: The beach will close for the winter.

closing.en: shutting something so it cannot be used
closing.ex: Closing the bridge caused long delays.

closure.ex: The closure of the factory hit the town hard.

closures.ex: Road closures are expected this weekend.

club.en: a group of people who share a hobby
club.ex: She joined a walking club last year.

collapsed.en: fell suddenly to a very low level
collapsed.ex: Fish numbers collapsed after the oil spill.

come.en: to move to a place (here: return)

compulsory.en: required by a rule or law
compulsory.ex: Wearing a helmet is compulsory on building sites.

example.en: Swimming lessons are compulsory at this school.
example.zh: 這所學校的游泳課是必修的。

note.meaning: （依法律或規定）強制的、必須做的。
note.usage: 常見 compulsory education/measures/testing；make sth compulsory；同義詞 mandatory，反義 voluntary/optional。

noteEn.meaning: required by a law or rule.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las clases de natación son obligatorias en esta escuela.
noteEs.meaning: exigido por una ley o norma; obligatorio.
noteEs.usage: Se usa compulsory education/measures; make sth compulsory; lo contrario es voluntary.

noteHi.exampleTr: इस स्कूल में तैराकी की कक्षाएँ अनिवार्य हैं।
noteHi.usage: compulsory education/measures; make sth compulsory; विलोम voluntary।

noteJa.exampleTr: この学校では水泳の授業が必修だ。
noteJa.meaning: 法律や規則で義務づけられた。
noteJa.usage: compulsory education/measures、make 〜 compulsory の形が多い。反意語は voluntary。

noteKo.meaning: 법이나 규정에 따라 반드시 해야 하는.
noteKo.usage: compulsory education/measures, make ~ compulsory 형태가 흔하며 반대말은 voluntary이다.

concluded.ex: The talks concluded late on Sunday.

consequently.ex: It rained all week; consequently, the match was cancelled.

conservation.ex: Conservation groups are planting trees along the coast.

example.en: Conservation efforts have brought otters back to the river.
example.zh: 保育工作讓水獺重回這條河。

note.meaning: 對自然環境、野生動植物或資源的保護與保育。
note.usage: 常見 wildlife/marine conservation、conservation area/efforts；形容詞 conservation-minded。注意與 conversation（對話）拼法不同。

noteEn.meaning: protecting nature, animals and natural resources.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los esfuerzos de conservación han devuelto las nutrias al río.
noteEs.meaning: protección de la naturaleza, la fauna o los recursos.
noteEs.usage: Se usa wildlife conservation, conservation efforts; no confundir con conversation.

noteHi.exampleTr: संरक्षण प्रयासों से ऊदबिलाव नदी में वापस आ गए हैं।
noteHi.meaning: प्रकृति, वन्यजीव या संसाधनों की रक्षा करना।
noteHi.usage: wildlife conservation, conservation efforts आम हैं; conversation (बातचीत) से अलग है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 保護活動のおかげでカワウソが川に戻ってきた。
noteJa.meaning: 自然・野生生物・資源を守ること。
noteJa.usage: wildlife conservation、conservation efforts などの形が多い。conversation（会話）と混同しないこと。

noteKo.exampleTr: 보전 노력 덕분에 수달이 강으로 돌아왔다.
noteKo.meaning: 자연, 야생 동식물, 자원을 보호하는 것.
noteKo.usage: wildlife conservation, conservation efforts 등으로 쓰며 conversation(대화)과 혼동하지 말 것.

consideration.ex: Several new designs are under consideration.

considered.ex: The bridge is considered safe for cars.

consultation.en: asking the public for their opinions on a plan
consultation.ex: The council opened a consultation on new bus routes.

example.en: The government launched a consultation on school meals.
example.zh: 政府針對學校午餐展開了公眾諮詢。

note.meaning: 政府或機構在做決定前，正式徵詢公眾或相關團體的意見。
note.usage: 常見 public consultation；a consultation on + 主題；launch/open/close a consultation。另有「諮詢、看診」之意。

noteEn.meaning: a formal process of asking the public for opinions before deciding.

noteEs.exampleTr: El gobierno abrió una consulta sobre los comedores escolares.
noteEs.meaning: proceso formal para pedir la opinión del público antes de decidir.
noteEs.usage: Se dice public consultation; a consultation on + tema; launch/close a consultation.

noteHi.exampleTr: सरकार ने स्कूल भोजन पर एक जन-परामर्श शुरू किया।
noteHi.meaning: निर्णय से पहले जनता या समूहों से औपचारिक रूप से राय लेना।
noteHi.usage: public consultation; a consultation on + विषय; launch/close a consultation आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 政府は学校給食についての意見公募を始めた。
noteJa.meaning: 決定の前に市民や関係者の意見を正式に聞くこと。
noteJa.usage: public consultation、a consultation on + テーマ、launch/close a consultation がよく使われる。

noteKo.exampleTr: 정부는 학교 급식에 관한 의견 수렴을 시작했다.
noteKo.meaning: 결정 전에 대중이나 관련 단체의 의견을 공식적으로 묻는 절차.
noteKo.usage: public consultation, a consultation on + 주제, launch/close a consultation이 흔하다.

contend.en: to say firmly that something is true
contend.ex: Critics contend that the plan costs too much.

example.en: Residents contend that the new road is too noisy.

note.meaning: 堅定地主張、聲稱某事是真的（常在爭論中）。
note.usage: contend that + 子句；正式用語，多見於辯論或報導。contend with 則是「應付（困難）」，意思不同。

noteEn.meaning: to say firmly that something is true, often in a debate.
noteEn.usage: 'contend that…' is formal; 'contend with' means 'deal with'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los vecinos sostienen que la nueva carretera es demasiado ruidosa.
noteEs.meaning: afirmar con firmeza algo en una discusión.
noteEs.usage: contend that + oración es formal; contend with significa 'lidiar con'.

noteHi.exampleTr: निवासियों का दावा है कि नई सड़क बहुत शोर करती है।
noteHi.meaning: बहस में दृढ़ता से दावा करना कि कुछ सच है।
noteHi.usage: contend that + उपवाक्य औपचारिक है; contend with का अर्थ 'कठिनाई से निपटना' है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 住民たちは新しい道路がうるさすぎると主張している。
noteJa.meaning: 議論の中で何かが正しいと強く主張すること。
noteJa.usage: contend that + 節 は改まった表現。contend with は「〜に対処する」で意味が異なる。

noteKo.exampleTr: 주민들은 새 도로가 너무 시끄럽다고 주장한다.
noteKo.meaning: 논쟁에서 어떤 것이 사실이라고 강하게 주장하다.
noteKo.usage: contend that + 절은 격식체이며, contend with는 '(어려움에) 대처하다'라는 다른 뜻이다.

contending.en: saying firmly that something is true
contending.ex: She wrote to the paper, contending the test was unfair.

example.en: Residents contend that the new road is too noisy.

note.meaning: 堅定地主張、聲稱某事是真的（常在爭論中）。
note.usage: contend that + 子句；正式用語，多見於辯論或報導。contend with 則是「應付（困難）」，意思不同。

noteEn.meaning: to say firmly that something is true, often in a debate.
noteEn.usage: 'contend that…' is formal; 'contend with' means 'deal with'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los vecinos sostienen que la nueva carretera es demasiado ruidosa.
noteEs.meaning: afirmar con firmeza algo en una discusión.
noteEs.usage: contend that + oración es formal; contend with significa 'lidiar con'.

noteHi.exampleTr: निवासियों का दावा है कि नई सड़क बहुत शोर करती है।
noteHi.meaning: बहस में दृढ़ता से दावा करना कि कुछ सच है।
noteHi.usage: contend that + उपवाक्य औपचारिक है; contend with का अर्थ 'कठिनाई से निपटना' है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 住民たちは新しい道路がうるさすぎると主張している。
noteJa.meaning: 議論の中で何かが正しいと強く主張すること。
noteJa.usage: contend that + 節 は改まった表現。contend with は「〜に対処する」で意味が異なる。

noteKo.exampleTr: 주민들은 새 도로가 너무 시끄럽다고 주장한다.
noteKo.meaning: 논쟁에서 어떤 것이 사실이라고 강하게 주장하다.
noteKo.usage: contend that + 절은 격식체이며, contend with는 '(어려움에) 대처하다'라는 다른 뜻이다.

contrast.ex: In contrast, the north stayed dry all summer.

cork.en: a city in the south of Ireland
cork.ja: コーク（アイルランドの都市）

curtailed.ex: Curtailed opening hours annoyed library users.
curtailed.hi: कटौती किए गए; छोटे किए गए
curtailed.ja: 短縮された；削減された

daily.ex: There is a daily limit of two tickets.

dam.en: a wall built across a river to hold water
dam.ex: The dam supplies power to the region.

dams.en: walls built across rivers to hold water
dams.ex: Old dams are being removed to help fish.

danger.en: the chance of harm or loss
danger.ex: The rare bird is in danger of dying out.

day.ex: You may catch one fish a day.

dead.ex: We found a dead bird in the garden.

decades.ex: The house has stood empty for decades.

decreased.ex: Crime has decreased in the city centre.

deemed.ex: The water was deemed safe to drink.

describes.en: says what someone or something is like
describes.ex: She describes her town as quiet and friendly.
describes.zh: 描述；把…形容為（describe X as Y）

dirty.ex: Dirty water can make people ill.

discussion.ex: The new plan is still under discussion.

disproportionately.en: much more than is fair or expected
disproportionately.ex: Price rises hit poorer families disproportionately.
disproportionately.hi: असमान रूप से; अनुपात से अधिक

example.zh: 洪水對較貧窮的社區影響特別大。

note.meaning: 不成比例地；比應有或合理的程度多（或少）得多。
note.usage: 常修飾 affect, hit, target 等動詞，或接形容詞（disproportionately high）；多用於批評不公平的情況。

noteEn.meaning: much more than is fair or expected.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las inundaciones afectan desproporcionadamente a los barrios más pobres.
noteEs.meaning: en una medida mucho mayor de lo justo o esperado.
noteEs.usage: Acompaña a verbos como affect, hit, target o adjetivos como high; suele indicar injusticia.

noteHi.exampleTr: बाढ़ गरीब इलाक़ों को असमान रूप से अधिक प्रभावित करती है।
noteHi.meaning: अनुपात से कहीं अधिक; उचित से ज़्यादा।
noteHi.usage: affect, hit, target जैसी क्रियाओं या high जैसे विशेषणों के साथ आता है; अन्याय दिखाने में प्रयोग होता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 洪水は貧しい地域に不釣り合いなほど大きな影響を与える。
noteJa.meaning: 妥当な程度よりはるかに多く；不釣り合いに。
noteJa.usage: affect, hit, target などの動詞や high などの形容詞と使い、不公平さを示すことが多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 홍수는 가난한 동네에 불균형적으로 큰 피해를 준다.
noteKo.meaning: 정당하거나 예상되는 정도보다 훨씬 더; 불균형적으로.
noteKo.usage: affect, hit, target 같은 동사나 high 같은 형용사와 함께 쓰며 불공평함을 나타낼 때 많다.

dwindled.ex: The village population has dwindled to a few hundred.

ebb.en: a low point (in 'at its lowest ebb')
ebb.ex: Morale in the team was at a low ebb.

eliminate.ex: Better design could eliminate most errors.

example.en: Good planning can eliminate most delays.
example.zh: 良好的規劃可以消除大部分延誤。

note.meaning: 完全消除、去除某事物或某人（使其不再存在或不再參與）。
note.usage: eliminate + 受詞（eliminate the risk/waste）；被動 be eliminated from（被淘汰）。比 remove 更強調「徹底」。

noteEn.usage: Use with an object: 'eliminate the risk', 'eliminate waste'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Una buena planificación puede eliminar la mayoría de los retrasos.
noteEs.meaning: quitar o hacer desaparecer algo por completo.
noteEs.usage: eliminate + objeto (eliminate the risk); be eliminated from = quedar fuera.

noteHi.exampleTr: अच्छी योजना ज़्यादातर देरी को समाप्त कर सकती है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को पूरी तरह हटा देना या समाप्त करना।
noteHi.usage: eliminate + कर्म (eliminate the risk); be eliminated from = बाहर होना।

noteJa.exampleTr: よい計画は遅れの大部分をなくすことができる。
noteJa.meaning: 完全に取り除く・なくすこと。
noteJa.usage: eliminate + 目的語（eliminate the risk）。be eliminated from は「敗退する」。remove より「完全に」の意味が強い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 좋은 계획은 대부분의 지연을 없앨 수 있다.
noteKo.usage: eliminate + 목적어(eliminate the risk); be eliminated from은 '탈락하다'. remove보다 '완전히'의 뜻이 강하다.

embraced.ex: Farmers embraced the new watering system.

emphasis.ex: The course puts emphasis on speaking skills.

example.en: The new course places emphasis on practical skills.

note.meaning: 對某事物給予的特別重視；重點。
note.usage: 固定搭配 put/place emphasis on sth；the emphasis on…；複數 emphases。動詞是 emphasise。

noteEn.usage: Use 'place emphasis on' or 'the emphasis on'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El nuevo curso pone énfasis en las habilidades prácticas.
noteEs.usage: Se dice put/place emphasis on algo; el verbo es emphasise.

noteHi.exampleTr: नया पाठ्यक्रम व्यावहारिक कौशल पर ज़ोर देता है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी बात को दिया गया विशेष महत्व; ज़ोर।
noteHi.usage: put/place emphasis on sth आम है; क्रिया emphasise है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい講座は実践的なスキルに重点を置いている。

paragraphs: Wild salmon are in trouble in Ireland. In the 1970s, more than one million salmon came back to Irish rivers each year. Now fewer than 200,000 come back.
Only 28% of Irish salmon rivers are healthy. The fishing agency, Inland Fisheries Ireland, wants big changes. New rules are planned for 2027. The fishing season may be shorter. Some rivers may close.
Some anglers in Cork are angry. They fish on the River Lee. They say fishing is not the main problem. They blame dirty water, dams and illegal fishing.
One angler says anglers are like guards on the river. They see pollution and dead fish first. Another group wants each angler to keep only three salmon a year.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭的野生鮭魚有麻煩了。
在1970年代，每年有超過一百萬條鮭魚游回愛爾蘭的河流。
現在回來的不到20萬條。
愛爾蘭只有28%的鮭魚河流是健康的。
漁業機構「愛爾蘭內陸漁業局」想要大幅改變。
新規定預計在2027年上路。
釣魚季節可能會縮短。
有些河流可能會關閉。
科克的一些釣客很生氣。
他們在利河上釣魚。
他們說釣魚不是主要的問題。
他們怪罪髒水、水壩和非法捕魚。
一位釣客說，釣客就像河上的守衛。
他們最先看到污染和死魚。
另一個團體希望每位釣客一年只能留下三條鮭魚。

paragraphs: Ireland's wild salmon are in serious danger. In the 1970s, more than a million salmon returned to Irish rivers every year, but in recent years the number has fallen to fewer than 200,000. Only 28% of the country's salmon rivers have healthy numbers of fish.

After a review, Inland Fisheries Ireland said urgent changes were needed. A public consultation on new rules from 2027 closed in October. Ideas include a shorter fishing season, closing some rivers, or letting anglers catch fish only if they put them back.

On the River Lee near Cork, the Lee Salmon Anglers Club, which has about 150 members, has rejected the plans. Members say anglers are being blamed unfairly. They point to pollution, sea lice from fish farms, illegal fishing and dams that stop salmon from swimming up the river.
Club secretary Alan Nolan says anglers act like guards. If rivers close, he says, nobody will report pollution or dead fish.
Another group, Salmon Watch Ireland, welcomes the focus on protecting fish. It suggests that each angler should keep no more than three salmon a year.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭的野生鮭魚正面臨嚴重危機。
在1970年代，每年有超過一百萬條鮭魚回到愛爾蘭的河流，但近幾年數量已降到不到20萬條。
全國只有28%的鮭魚河流擁有健康的魚群數量。
經過一次檢討後，愛爾蘭內陸漁業局表示需要緊急的改變。
針對2027年起新規定的公眾諮詢已於10月結束。
提出的構想包括縮短釣魚季、關閉部分河流，或只允許釣客在把魚放回去的前提下釣魚。
在科克附近的利河，擁有約150名會員的利河鮭魚釣客俱樂部已拒絕這些計畫。
會員們說釣客受到了不公平的指責。
他們指出污染、魚類養殖場的海蝨、非法捕魚，以及阻擋鮭魚逆流而上的水壩才是問題。
俱樂部祕書艾倫・諾蘭說，釣客就像守衛一樣。
他說，如果河流關閉，就沒有人會通報污染或死魚了。
另一個團體「愛爾蘭鮭魚守望」則歡迎把重點放在保護魚類上。
該團體建議每位釣客一年最多只能留下三條鮭魚。

paragraphs: Ireland's wild Atlantic salmon population has collapsed to one of its lowest levels in decades. Annual returns to Irish rivers have dropped from more than a million fish in the 1970s to fewer than 200,000, and just 28% of salmon rivers are considered to have healthy stocks.

A review by Inland Fisheries Ireland called for urgent and far-reaching change, and a public consultation on how fisheries should be managed from 2027 ended in October. Options under discussion include shorter seasons, river closures and catch-and-release fishing only.

On the River Lee outside Cork city, the local anglers' club has rejected the proposals outright. Its members argue that anglers are being unfairly targeted while bigger threats, such as water pollution, sea lice from salmon farms, poaching and the Inniscarra Dam, which blocks fish migration, go unaddressed.
Club secretary Alan Nolan describes the angler as a sentinel, warning that closing rivers would remove the people most likely to report pollution and fish kills.

Salmon Watch Ireland, however, has welcomed the focus on conservation. It supports managing each river separately and proposes a national limit of three salmon per angler each year, with no more than one a day.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭的野生大西洋鮭魚族群已崩跌至數十年來最低的水準之一。
每年洄游到愛爾蘭河流的鮭魚數量，已從1970年代的一百多萬條降到不到20萬條，而且只有28%的鮭魚河流被認為擁有健康的魚群。
愛爾蘭內陸漁業局的一份檢討報告呼籲進行緊急且影響深遠的改革，而一項關於2027年起漁業應如何管理的公眾諮詢已於10月結束。
正在討論的選項包括縮短漁季、封閉河流，以及只允許釣獲後放流。
在科克市郊的利河，當地的釣客俱樂部已斷然拒絕這些提案。
會員們主張，釣客受到不公平的針對，而更大的威脅——例如水污染、鮭魚養殖場的海蝨、盜獵，以及阻礙魚類洄游的伊尼斯卡拉水壩——卻無人處理。

paragraphs: Ireland's wild Atlantic salmon have dwindled to their lowest ebb in decades. Whereas more than a million fish once returned to Irish rivers each year in the 1970s, that figure has plummeted below 200,000, and a mere 28% of salmon rivers are deemed to hold healthy stocks.

Inland Fisheries Ireland has called for urgent, transformative change, and a public consultation on how the fisheries will be managed from 2027 wrapped up in October. Curtailed seasons, outright river closures and mandatory catch-and-release are all on the table.

On the River Lee, upstream of Cork city, the local anglers' club has rebuffed the proposals wholesale. Members contend that they are being scapegoated while graver threats, among them pollution, sea lice from fish farms, poaching and the Inniscarra Dam, which impedes migrating fish, are left unchecked.
Club secretary Alan Nolan casts the angler as a sentinel, arguing that shutting rivers would sideline the very people who raise the alarm over pollution and fish kills.

Salmon Watch Ireland, by contrast, has embraced the conservation emphasis, favouring river-by-river management and a national cap of three retained salmon per angler annually, with a daily limit of one.
